blocks.value: Volatility measures how much a stock's price moves over a period of time. Some stocks move very little, while others rise and fall rapidly.
Imagine This: One amusement park ride moves slowly and smoothly. Another is a fast roller coaster with sudden twists and drops. Stock prices behave in a similar way.
High volatility means prices change quickly and by larger amounts. Low volatility means prices move more steadily.
A stock moving from ₹100 to ₹130 and back to ₹105 within a week is considered more volatile than one moving gradually from ₹100 to ₹103.
High volatility creates both higher opportunities and higher risks.
⚠️ Volatility is not the same as risk. A good company can still experience short-term volatility.

blocks.question: Which stock is more volatile?
choices: A stock moving between ₹100 and ₹130 in a week.
A stock moving between ₹100 and ₹102 in a week.
